selection: Only nominal 80 ms streams are performance-qualified here. Keep the selected graph and its own state for the entire stream, including a terminal 40 ms call. Other packet sizes were correctness checks, not timing baselines.

80.reference_statistic: median of three rounds; each round sums decoder service over three 1.6-second prefixes and divides by 4.8 seconds

timing_protocol.timing_boundary: Sum of CPU Session.run service, including startup; excludes setup, encoding, validation, loop overhead and disk I/O
timing_protocol.note: This is an observed short-run reference, not a guaranteed latency or a replacement for paired controls in later experiments.

qualification.duplicate_record_note: The 114 unique full waveform/state transfer comparisons were logged twice, yielding 228 records; these are not independent recordings.
qualification.quality_claim: Transferred optimizations preserved existing selective INT8 PCM samples on the tested panel; this does not remove the existing INT8-versus-FP32 loss.

existing_quantization_quality_limits.limits: One recording per language, no music or high-band qualification, no subjective transparency claim; bootstrap confidence intervals are not meaningful with one observation per language.
existing_quantization_quality_limits.metric_identity: UTMOS22 strong SpeechMOS; DNSMOS non-personalized P.835 OVRL and P.808 are separate scores.

prepared_weight_memory_note: Packed paired projection adds about 32 MiB of prepared weights; preparation is outside the measured RTF.
original_spec_note: 80ms.json is a byte-for-byte copy of the measured combined spec. Its chunks [1,2] field records available correctness cases and does not establish a 40 ms performance baseline.
